{{Quote|The Jindas may return to the life they once loved beneath my fortress.|Rock Wizard|<ref name="The Curse of the Jindas">{{Ewoks|The Curse of the Jindas}}</ref>}}
The '''Rock Fortress''' was a mammoth structure on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]]. It was the home of the [[Rock Wizard]]. There was a window near the top of the fortress, which allowed the Rock Wizard to look out on the [[Jinda/Legends|Jinda]] [[Travelling Jindas|tribe]], who farmed the soil beneath the building.
